name: Southeastern New England

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A vast AVA covering thirteen counties in Connecticut, Massachusetts and Rhode Island, Cape Cod and Massachusetts Bay. It contains Martha's Vineyard.
